item.title: Tutorials & Notes
item.description: In these chapters we present a set of tutorials on different topics, most of them related to Bayesian inference, spatial and spatio-temporal models and inferential methods, as in a broader sense we treat topics in the general framework of computational statistics with theoretical and applied notes. Computational Statistics Bayesian Inference INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximations) This chapter covers INLA and inlabru.
